description_en: Queries the details of databases in a specified instance by calling the DescribeDrdsDBs operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeDrdsDBs接口查看实例下的数据库详情
kebab_example: aliyun drds describe-drds-dbs --drds-instance-id drdshbga11380000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDrdsDBs

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.

Default value: **30**
parameters.name: page_size
